name: Halfline Journal
tagline: The rest of the story, told slowly.
positioning: Halfline Journal is a multi-sport longform publication that treats athletes, grounds and seasons with the patience of documentary photojournalism, publishing fewer stories that go much further.
audience: Thoughtful sports readers aged 25-55 who follow several sports, read weekend features, listen to documentary podcasts and want the human story behind results rather than another hot take.
strategy: Own the slow lane of sports media: one flagship longform feature a week, serialised in numbered chapters, with a strong monochrome visual identity that stands out in colour-saturated sports feeds. Social works as a trailer for the chapters (carousel covers, contact sheets, reporting notes) and drives sign-ups to the Sunday Long Read newsletter. All stories in this concept are clearly labelled SAMPLE STORY and feature fictional athletes, teams and places.

contrastPairs.use: body text and headlines on newsprint
kickers, links and SAMPLE labels on newsprint
button and CTA text on red
captions and metadata on darkroom sections
red kicker text on darkroom sections (tint of Rule Red)

fonts.mono: none (Libre Franklin tabular figures for data)

designSystem.spacing: 8px base unit; generous vertical rhythm of 64-128px between features; text columns capped near 68 characters
designSystem.radius: 0 everywhere: square plates, square buttons, square tags, like a printed broadsheet
designSystem.borders: Hairline 1px ink column rules, 4px ink masthead rules, double rules around the masthead, short 4-6px red rule segments marking kickers and captions
designSystem.imagery: Original grainy monochrome illustration plates (SVG noise filter over grey gradients) with simplified silhouettes of athletes, grounds and equipment; never stock photography; every plate carries a numbered caption
designSystem.shapes: Rectangles and hard horizontal lines; the halved-circle mark referencing a halfway line; film-strip sprockets and contact-sheet frames
designSystem.buttons: Square solid red buttons with white uppercase tracked Libre Franklin labels; secondary buttons are 2px ink outlines that invert on hover
designSystem.cards: Borderless story cards separated by column rules: plate, red kicker, serif headline, deck, byline, SAMPLE STORY tag
designSystem.motifs: Large chapter numerals in DM Serif Display, drop caps, red rule lines, pull quotes, captions with plate numbers, contact sheets marked in red grease pencil

artDirection: Every creative should feel like a page lifted from a serious weekend broadsheet: newsprint or darkroom black backgrounds, one grainy monochrome plate, and red used sparingly as a rule, a circle or a single call to action. Headlines are set big in DM Serif Display with an italic second line, supported by small tracked Libre Franklin kickers and captions. Chapter numerals, plate captions and SAMPLE STORY labels appear on every piece so the series logic is legible at a glance. Avoid colour photography, gradients in hue, emoji and stadium-hype language.
